claims.claim_text: 改成讓它寫程式在 14 個模型中的 11 個上追平或勝出
claims.evidence: Programmatic tool calling matches or exceeds native JSON tool calling in 11 of 14 models on BFCL v4
claims.note: Bound to item #03's source (arxiv 2608.06370v1). Numerals and the match-or-exceed framing are the abstract's own.

claims.claim_text: WebMCP 讓網站直接宣告自己有哪些工具，agent 不必再從給人看的頁面猜
claims.evidence: agents no longer have to guess their way through a page built for humans. This enables agents to have a different browsing experience from the user and use tokens on tasks, not navigation.
claims.note: Bound to item #06's source (blog.cloudflare.com/webmcp). The 'guess from human-facing pages' framing is Cloudflare's own wording.

claims.claim_text: RFC 10023 讓網域在 DNS 裡直說自己願意賣，不必先把首頁換成停放頁
claims.evidence: The homepage keeps serving, the mail keeps flowing, and the record can be added and removed at will.
claims.note: Bound to item #04's source. RFC 10023 (Informational, July 2026) defines _for-sale; the 'no parking page needed' contrast is the spec's own non-replacement framing.

claims.claim_text: eMicro 指出單看一跳合法看不出整條呼叫路徑違規
claims.evidence: Traditional inter-service access control restricts individual service-to-service requests, but fails to prevent multi-hop attacks, where each hop appears legitimate yet the overall path violates security intent.
claims.note: Bound to item #10's source (arxiv 2608.05300v1). Direct restatement of the abstract's gap sentence.

claims.claim_text: Eufy 門鈴的隱藏網路則因為全機種共用同一把金鑰而失去「隱藏」的意義
claims.evidence: This gives us the string used as key to encrypt/decrypt the configutation file: C0C714B43806EF49 => 43304337313442343338303645463439. It's derived from hardcoded data, so it should be the same between devices.
claims.note: Adversarial re-read finds NO statement that the key is shared across all devices or all models. The author writes only 'it should be the same between devices' — an explicit inference hedged with 'should'. 「全機種共用同一把金鑰」 upgraded a hedged conjecture into an asserted fleet-wide fact, and 「全機種」 went further than the source's 'between devices'.
claims.fix: Rewritten to 「Eufy 門鈴那把解設定檔的金鑰全從韌體常數推導，作者推測各裝置間應該相同，隱藏網路的「隱藏」也就跟著失效」 — restores the source's 'should' hedge, attributes the inference to the author, and drops 全機種.

claims.claim_text: Assembly Hall of Shame 提醒你：指令延遲表上那個數字，從來不是那道指令唯一可能的成本
claims.evidence: Instructions may use whatever setup is necessary, but only a single instruction is eligible to be scored. ... Score: 198,002,498,236 cycles | Time: 62 seconds
claims.note: Framing sentence, but a fair restatement of the repo's stated premise. Not presented as a quotation.

claims.claim_text: setup 隨你怎麼鋪，但只有一道指令列入計分，時間以 CPU base clock 正規化，硬體必須是原廠出廠狀態
claims.evidence: Instructions may use whatever setup is necessary, but only a single instruction is eligible to be scored. ... Times are normalized based on the CPU base clock frequency. All platforms must be in their factory stock configurations - no hardware modifications.
claims.note: All three rules re-fetched verbatim from the README rules section.

claims.claim_text: idiv 用 128 位元被除數把除法器的 microcode 走滿是 77 cycles
claims.evidence: #24 - idiv: "Use 128-bit dividend (rdx:rax=2:0) with small divisor to push the quotient above the ceiling imposed by sign-extension" - Score: 77 cycles
claims.note: Number and setup confirmed. The mechanism gloss paraphrases 'push the quotient above the ceiling imposed by sign-extension'; the source does not use the word microcode for this entry, but this is not a numeric or attributive error.

claims.claim_text: mfence 在 write-combining buffer 塞滿時是 326 cycles
claims.evidence: #19 - mfence: "Saturate all write-combining line-fill buffers with movnti stores to distinct cache lines" - Score: 326 cycles | Time: 120 nanoseconds

claims.claim_text: rdrand 在熵池耗盡時是 5,579 cycles
claims.evidence: #13 - rdrand: "Execute in a tight loop to deplete the hardware entropy pool faster than it can be refilled" - Score: 5,579 cycles | Time: 2.057 microseconds

claims.claim_text: Zen 上對 MCG_CTL 下 wrmsr 是 34,304 cycles
claims.evidence: #12 - wrmsr: "MCG_CTL on Zen look like a winner: may be a microcode quiesce and synchronize on MCA error banks" - Score: 34,304 cycles | Time: 10.742 microseconds
claims.note: The post asserts only the cycle count and the MSR/microarchitecture, which are stated flatly; the source's 'may be' hedge attaches to the explanation, which the post does not repeat. No inflation.

claims.claim_text: 冠軍是 fxrstor64：512 位元組的狀態從高延遲 MMIO 載入，同時用其他核心把 PCIe root complex 打滿，量到 198,002,498,236 cycles，也就是 62 秒
claims.evidence: Use fxrstor64 to load 512-byte FPU/MMX/XMM state from a high-latency MMIO region in the PCIe fabric, then starve the fabric while the load is in flight - a fleet of hammer cores pounds a different high-latency MMIO register with tight 4-byte reads, saturating the PCIe root complex and endpoint with non-posted transactions, so CPU 0's 512-byte fxrstor64 must queue behind all that contending traffic. Score: 198,002,498,236 cycles | Time: 62 seconds
claims.note: Re-fetched the #1 entry specifically. '512-byte' and 'saturating the PCIe root complex' are verbatim. Digit-for-digit match on the cycle count and the 62-second conversion.

claims.claim_text: 先靠 90:bf:d9 這個 OUI 掃出 HomeBase，送 500 個廣播 deauth
claims.evidence: OUI prefix: "90:bf:d9" ... "for x in range(0,500): sendp(packet, iface=iface, verbose=False)"
claims.note: OUI and the literal loop bound of 500 both present in the article's PoC snippet.

claims.claim_text: 把門鈴踢離管理網路
claims.evidence: the hidden network is called OCEAN_XXXXXX, being the suffix the last 24 bits of Homebase's MAC. ... You can remotely flood it with deauth packets and make it disconnect from the hidden network, so the video/audio is recorded locally but not streamed to the Homebase/mobile app
claims.note: The article never uses the term 'management network'. The network the deauth kicks the doorbell off is the HomeBase's hidden AP (OCEAN_XXXXXX) — the media/streaming link, not a management plane.
claims.fix: Rewritten to 「送 500 個廣播 deauth 把門鈴踢離 HomeBase 的隱藏網路，影像改成只錄在本機、不再上傳」 — names the network the source names and states the consequence the source states.

claims.claim_text: 19 個頻率、150 Hz 間距、每個符號約 65 到 70 毫秒
claims.evidence: "19 Frequencies were used" ... "150 Hz of difference between them" ... "Symbols had a aprox duration of 65ms" ... "I estimated that setting 69.75ms as symbol duration would work"
claims.note: Checked adversarially. 19 and 150 Hz are verbatim (the firmware loop's 0x96 stride = 150 corroborates). The symbol duration is not given as a range in the source: 65 ms is the initial estimate, 69.75 ms the value actually used. Both endpoints are literally in the source and the post hedges with 約, so this passes — but it is a synthesis of two figures, not a quoted range.

claims.claim_text: 前段用 Reed-Solomon、最後一段用 CRC-16
claims.evidence: Reed-Solomon coding processes 15-nibble blocks with "two parity nibbles" for single-error correction, while shortened blocks use "CRC-16" validation.
claims.note: The source's split is full 15-nibble RS blocks vs a shortened trailing block validated by CRC-16, which the post renders as 前段/最後一段. Accurate.

claims.claim_text: 最後用 Raspberry Pi 從測試點把 16 MB SPI flash 讀出來
claims.evidence: Luckly I could dump it connecting test hooks to the flash memory and using the SPI0 interface
claims.note: Two re-fetches targeted at the flash size found no capacity anywhere in the article — no '16 MB', no '128 Mbit', no chip part number. The Raspberry Pi / test-point / SPI dump is supported; the 16 MB figure is not in the cited source. Exactly the fabricated-numeral pattern the authenticity pass exists to catch.
claims.fix: Capacity dropped. Rewritten to 「最後用 Raspberry Pi 接上測試點，透過 SPI0 把門鈴的快閃記憶體讀出來」 — keeps only what the source states.

claims.claim_text: 一段寫死的 64 位元組字串與 0x01、0x04、0x06 的重複樣式 XOR 之後取 MD5，就是解開 es_config 的 AES-128-ECB 金鑰
claims.evidence: "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789~_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" is XORed with a "repeating group of three bytes (0x01, 0x04, 0x06)", then processed through MD5 hashing ... used for "AES-128-ECB" decryption of the es_config file
claims.note: The hardcoded string quoted in the article is 64 characters long (26 + 10 + 2 + 26), so 64 位元組 checks out; XOR pattern, MD5, AES-128-ECB and es_config all verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 而這把金鑰所有裝置共用
claims.evidence: It's derived from hardcoded data, so it should be the same between devices.
claims.note: Same defect as c05, in the item lede. The source states a hedged inference; the post asserted it as established fact about all devices.
claims.fix: Rewritten to 「因為推導過程全靠寫死的資料，作者判斷這把金鑰在各裝置間應該是同一把」 — restores the source's 'should' hedge and attributes the inference to the author.

claims.claim_text: 在 BFCL v4 上跨 14 個模型比較，programmatic tool calling 在其中 11 個追平或勝出
claims.evidence: we empirically compare programmatic tool calling (PTC) to native JSON tool calling across 14 language models on BFCL v4 ... Programmatic tool calling matches or exceeds native JSON tool calling in 11 of 14 models on BFCL v4

claims.claim_text: GPT-5.6 家族相對 JSON 基準線是 10.6% 的改善
claims.evidence: with the GPT-5.6 family achieving a 10.6% improvement over the JSON tool calling baseline

claims.claim_text: 平行 fan-out 時 13 個模型追平或勝出
claims.evidence: it matches or outperforms baseline in 13 of 14 models under parallel fan-out
claims.note: Post drops the '/14' denominator but the count is correct and the denominator is established earlier in the same sentence.

claims.claim_text: 在 context rot 條件下基準線平均退化 2.3%，程式碼那條路維持穩定
claims.evidence: and holds stable under context rot conditions where baseline degrades 2.3% on average
claims.note: Direction of the comparison preserved: the baseline degrades, PTC holds stable.

claims.claim_text: 把工具寫成帶型別的 Python stub、讓模型用程式碼去呼叫，執行與取回結果都在同一個 agent turn 內完成
claims.evidence: tools are exposed as typed Python stubs that the model invokes through code, with execution and results handled in a single agent turn

claims.claim_text: RFC 10023 定義了一筆放在 _for-sale 底下的 TXT 記錄，格式從 v=FORSALE1 這個版本標籤開始，後面帶 ftxt、furi、fval 或 fcod 其中一個
claims.evidence: RFC 10023 (Informational, July 2026) defines _for-sale as a reserved DNS leaf node ... TXT record structure: "v=FORSALE1;tag=value" ... permits: ftxt= (free text), furi= (contact URI), fval= (asking price), fcod= (proprietary code). Only one tag-value pair per record is allowed
claims.note: RFC number, underscore label, mandatory case-sensitive version tag, the four keys, and the exactly-one-per-record rule all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 願意賣的人沒有辦法讓有興趣的買家知道，除非對方寄冷信給多半已被隱私遮蔽移除的 WHOIS 聯絡人
claims.evidence: If you are willing to sell, the interested buyer has no way to learn that short of a cold email to a WHOIS contact that privacy redaction has probably removed.
claims.note: Close paraphrase of the spec's own problem statement, with 'probably removed' preserved as 多半.

claims.claim_text: 「首頁繼續服務，郵件繼續流動」，靠的是 RFC 8552 的底線節點命名慣例，TTL 建議壓在 3600 秒以內
claims.evidence: The homepage keeps serving, the mail keeps flowing, and the record can be added and removed at will. ... RFC 8552 ... "Scoped Interpretation of DNS Resource Records through Underscored Node Names" ... Keep the TTL at 3600 seconds or less.
claims.note: Quotation is a faithful translation of a verbatim source clause; RFC 8552 role and the 3600-second ceiling both confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 規格也直說沒簽 DNSSEC 的記錄「是別人偽造起來很舒服的東西」，而 ftxt 與 furi 都是攻擊者可控的內容，顯示前要消毒
claims.evidence: An unsigned TXT record asserting your domain is for sale, at a price, with a contact URI, is a comfortable thing for someone else to forge. ... Sanitise before display
claims.note: 「很舒服的東西」 tracks 'a comfortable thing'; the sanitisation requirement for attacker-controlled ftxt/furi is the spec's own security consideration.

claims.claim_text: TensorCast 提出的是 Tensor-as-a-Service：一層分散式張量管理，給出「第一級的張量抽象、可程式化的生命週期原語，以及把張量管理策略與執行機制分開的 runtime」，已經接上 vLLM 與 SGLang
claims.evidence: We design and build TensorCast, a distributed tensor management layer that provides first-class tensor abstractions, programmable lifecycle primitives, and a runtime that separates tensor management policies from execution mechanisms. ... We integrate TensorCast with vLLM and SGLang
claims.note: Quoted triple is a faithful translation of the abstract clause; both engine integrations confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 論文回報在高併發多輪 agent 工作負載下，中位數 TTFT 改善 93.2%
claims.evidence: A programmable policy implemented with TensorCast improves median TTFT by up to 93.2% under highly concurrent multi-turn agent workloads.
claims.note: The numeral and the workload condition are right, but the source's bound is 'by up to 93.2%' — a ceiling, not the achieved figure. The post dropped 'up to' and stated it flatly, and also dropped that the gain belongs to one programmable policy rather than TensorCast generally.
claims.fix: Rewritten to 「一組用 TensorCast 寫出來的可程式化策略讓中位數 TTFT 最多改善 93.2%」 — restores 最多 and the policy attribution.

claims.claim_text: WebMCP 是「一個新的瀏覽器標準，在 Chrome 146 實驗性推出，在頁面裡以 document.modelContext 出現」
claims.evidence: a new browser standard, shipping experimentally in Chrome 146, that shows up in the page as document.modelContext
claims.note: Quotation matches the source clause phrase-for-phrase, including the Chrome 146 version number.

claims.claim_text: 網站用 registerTool() 註冊工具，型別直接沿用 MCP 自己的 Tool 與 CallToolResult
claims.evidence: registers each with .registerTool. A pack is just a set of MCP tool descriptors and their handlers. ... We use Model Context Protocol's own Tool and CallToolResult types

claims.claim_text: 打開之後用 HTMLRewriter 在每份 HTML 回應裡插一行 bridge script 的參照，origin 完全不用改
claims.evidence: Switch it on and browser agents can start working with your site, with no code and nothing changed at your origin. ... we use HTMLRewriter to add one line to each HTML response
claims.note: One-line injection per HTML response, HTMLRewriter, and the untouched origin all stated; 'bridge script' is the post's label for the injected line.

claims.claim_text: 這個預覽版裡「每個工具都完全跑在訪客的瀏覽器裡，不會繞到我們的伺服器」
claims.evidence: In this preview, every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser. There is no round trip to a server of ours.
claims.note: The post preserves the source's 'In this preview' scoping rather than presenting it as a permanent guarantee.

claims.claim_text: 要接自家 MCP server 時也是從頁面上用訪客既有的 session 直連
claims.evidence: The Site MCP Server pack talks straight to your MCP server endpoint from the page, on the visitor's origin and with their existing session.

claims.claim_text: DeepMind 的 WeatherNext 把路徑、強度與風場結構收進同一個模型，訓練資料是將近 20 TB 的全球大氣資料加上 IBTrACS 裡近 5,000 場歷史風暴
claims.evidence: It is a single AI model that predicts a tropical cyclone's track, intensity, and wind structure with state-of-the-art accuracy. ... nearly 20 terabytes of global atmospheric data ... the historical IBTrACS database spanning nearly 5,000 historical storms
claims.note: Both 'nearly' hedges preserved as 將近/近.

claims.claim_text: 用 Functional Generative Networks 產生系集，一個氣旋可以跑出 1,000 種可能情境
claims.evidence: Our model uses [Functional Generative Networks (FGNs)] to efficiently produce ensembles of different predictions ... we are now predicting 1,000 possible scenarios for each cyclone
claims.note: Re-fetched specifically to confirm FGN is the named ensemble method rather than the post's own attribution. Confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 官方給的說法是「我們的三天預報，跟先前模型只能提供的兩天預報一樣好」，等於整整多出 24 小時的前置時間
claims.evidence: our three-day forecasts are as good as what prior models were able to provide for only the next two days. ... On average, WeatherNext Cyclones gains more than a full day (24 hours) of lead time advantage
claims.note: Quotation verbatim in translation. The 24-hour framing is if anything weaker than the source ('more than a full day', 'on average'), so deflated — recorded, no action.

claims.claim_text: 一次 15 天的預報在 TPU 上不到一分鐘
claims.evidence: We can now generate a single 15-day forecast in less than a minute on a TPU

claims.claim_text: 它跑在 28×28 公里這種相對粗的解析度上，DeepMind 自己也說為什麼還能這麼準「仍是尚待理解的開放研究問題」
claims.evidence: WeatherNext Cyclones only needs data with a resolution of 28x28km, 100x coarser than traditional models. ... it remains an open research question to fully understand how our models produce such accurate predictions at this resolution.
claims.note: Resolution figure and the open-question quotation both verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 成立約十個月的 Nixpkgs core team 在 8 月 7 日宣布解散，職掌涵蓋專案方向、決策、與 NixOS Foundation Board 的協調以及團隊的建立與管理
claims.evidence: Announced August 7, 2026 ... "achievements over the past 10 months" ... "Project Direction, Decision-Making, Coordination with the NixOS Foundation Board, and Creation and Management of Teams, where they pertain to Nixpkgs"
claims.note: 約十個月 correctly hedges 'the past 10 months'. Remit list matches item-for-item.

claims.claim_text: 這個角色與實際的技術貢獻難以並存
claims.evidence: has sadly not turned out to be the lightweight role compatible with active technical contribution that we had originally hoped it would be
claims.note: Rendered as a paraphrase (not inside 「」), appropriate since the source frames it as a disappointed expectation.

claims.claim_text: 他們形容 Steering Committee 這個機構「缺乏授權的本能直覺」、溝通長期不良，以及「對於我們是否被信任能自主做決定的普遍不確定」
claims.evidence: lacks a native instinct for the delegation envisioned by the constitution ... chronically poor communication ... general uncertainty about whether we are trusted to autonomously make decisions within our remit
claims.note: Both bracketed quotations are faithful translations. 「缺乏授權的本能直覺」 compresses the constitutional referent but does not change strength or direction.

claims.claim_text: 招募也接不上——公開徵人只有一個人主動應徵
claims.evidence: With only one person actively applying in response to our call for new members and mixed response to outreach, recruiting sufficiently to keep things healthy looks untenable.
claims.note: 'only one person actively applying' maps exactly, including the 'actively' nuance.

claims.claim_text: 現在這塊的事務「目前沒有直接的負責人，SC 一如既往作為最後的後盾」，而 SC 改選在即
claims.evidence: The matters in our jurisdiction are left with no direct owner at present, with the SC acting as the final backstop as always. ... [SC elections occurring] "imminently"
claims.note: Quotation faithful. Volatile-timeliness claim but the source is two days old relative to the post date, so no dated-attribution hedge is required.

claims.claim_text: MiniMax-H3 是本週 Hugging Face trending 的第一名
claims.note: Two passes over the cited model card found no mention of trending status or any Hugging Face ranking. The item cites only the model card, which cannot support a ranking claim about the surrounding platform; no second source is cited. An unsupported superlative in the lede's opening position.
claims.fix: Ranking clause deleted outright. The lede now opens on the architecture claim the model card does support: 「MiniMax-H3 架構上刻意走「不分模態」的路線」. The routine's own Hub trending fetch did rank it first at fetch time, but that is not the cited source and a point-in-time API score does not support 本週.

claims.claim_text: 33B 參數的 dense 單流 Transformer，其中約 13B 落在 AdaLN 相關分支
claims.evidence: H3-Omni-Transformer is a 33B-parameter dense, single-stream Transformer, with approximately 13B parameters residing in AdaLN-related branches.
claims.note: 'approximately' preserved as 約.

claims.claim_text: attention 與 FFN 層裡沒有任何模態專屬結構，位置編碼用三維的 MM-RoPE
claims.evidence: Neither the attention layers nor the FFN layers contain modality-specific structures. ... Three-dimensional Multimodal Rotary Position Embeddings (MM-RoPE) ... across the temporal and two spatial dimensions, (t, h, w)

claims.claim_text: H3-VisualVAE 是 16 倍空間、4 倍時間壓縮，H3-AudioVAE 處理 32 kHz 立體聲，輸出可以到 15 秒、24 FPS 的影片配 32 kHz 立體聲
claims.evidence: Spatial compression factor of 16x, a temporal compression factor of 4x, and 24 latent channels, denoted as f16t4d24. ... H3-AudioVAE compresses 32 kHz audio ... Output duration 4-15 seconds ... 24 FPS ... 32 kHz stereo
claims.note: The card gives output duration as a 4-15 second range; 「可以到 15 秒」 takes the ceiling and marks it as a ceiling, which is accurate.

claims.claim_text: 長序列的 sparse attention 沒有包在這次開源裡
claims.evidence: The sparse-attention implementation is not included in the initial open-source release and will be published separately in a future update.

claims.claim_text: 典型部署要 4 張 GPU
claims.evidence: The SGLang deployment example shows --num-gpus 4 for both FL2VA and Ref2VA variants.
claims.note: Re-checked specifically for a stated hardware requirement: the card states no recommended, minimum or typical GPU count anywhere. The only '4' is a flag value inside an SGLang example command. 「典型部署要」 converted an example invocation into a requirement the source never states.
claims.fix: Rewritten to 「官方說會另外發布；SGLang 的部署範例用的是 4 張 GPU」 — attributes the figure to the example command it actually comes from, and adds the card's own statement about the separate sparse-attention release.

claims.claim_text: 「每一跳看起來都合法，整條路徑卻違反了安全意圖」
claims.evidence: multi-hop attacks, where each hop appears legitimate yet the overall path violates security intent
claims.note: Verbatim translation of the abstract clause; the post correctly frames it as describing the attack class rather than eMicro's result.

claims.claim_text: 追蹤呼叫順序、把策略編成 DFA 來快速驗證、用 eBPF 在 kernel 層攔請求
claims.evidence: (1) history-based access control extended to capture service invocation sequences; (2) security policies encoded as efficient deterministic finite automaton (DFA), supporting constant-time lookups and compact label propagation; (3) eBPF-based in-kernel request tracing for transparent, low-overhead enforcement without code changes.
claims.note: All three techniques map one-to-one onto the abstract's numbered list.

claims.claim_text: 策略檢查 1 微秒、5,000 萬條策略只佔 100 MB、傳遞開銷降低 90%
claims.evidence: eMicro performs policy checks in 1 microsecond, stores 50 million policies in only 100 MB, and reduces propagation overhead by 90% with negligible runtime impact.
claims.note: All three numerals exact; 5,000 萬 = 50 million.

claims.claim_text: 評估用的是 Uber、Alibaba 與 ByteDance 數以百萬計的真實工作流程
claims.evidence: Evaluations on DeathStarBench and production cloud traces from Uber, Alibaba, and ByteDance, covering 12 million request workflows and thousands of services
claims.note: '12 million request workflows' supports 數以百萬計 (the post rounds down into a vaguer band rather than inflating). The post omits DeathStarBench, which is an omission, not a misstatement.

claims.claim_text: 論文已被 CCS 2026 接受
claims.evidence: Acceptance status: Yes, accepted at ACM CCS 2026
claims.note: Stated on the arXiv listing page for 2608.05300v1.
